description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Requirements Your most recent action was to Cast a composition Spell.

You leverage a performance's most captivating moments to distract your foes and create an opening for your allies. You [[/act feint skill=performance]] using Performance instead of Deception against a target within 30 feet. Feinting this way gains the visual trait. If you succeed, you can choose an ally within reach of the target; the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard] to that ally's melee attacks instead of your own.
